name: Briviesca (Spain)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Briviesca (red with two hands holding rings above wavy stripes).
history: The current flag of Briviesca is of recent creation and was not the result of any study or municipal agreement: while Antonio López-Linares was mayor it was thought convenient to give the city a flag that could be hoisted during the local festivities, using the arms adopted by the corporation in plenary session on 27 September 1927.

features.role: Briviesca arms — hands holding rings above waves
